market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Ukraine's official stance remains pro-NATO, but a peace deal may require a commitment to neutrality. The broad resolution criteria—any pledge, even unilateral or for a limited time—raises the chance of Yes. Recent signals (e.g., Zelenskyy's openness to discuss neutrality) and international pressure make a pledge plausible before 2027.
evidence_points: 2022 Istanbul negotiations included Ukrainian neutrality proposals.
Western officials have hinted at security guarantees in lieu of NATO membership.
Public Ukrainian opinion strongly favors NATO but may accept a temporary freeze as a compromise.
sources_consulted: News coverage of Ukraine peace talks (various outlets, prior to 2025)
Official statements from Ukrainian and NATO officials
